A LISTENING LOG, 2010–2026

Sixteen years
on repeat.

Every track you played, logged and re-strung into a shape. This is what stuck around long enough to become a habit — and what came and went in a season.

Artist and year filters apply to the artist chart and track list. Genre and year apply to the genre chart.

Artist rotation

Plays for your top 12 artists across your listening history. Ranked by lifetime total, or by that year's total when you pick a year above — click a name to trace it.

Genre rotation

Plays for your top 12 genres, based on each artist's primary Last.fm tag — covers 99.1% of your total plays across 336 genres. Ranked by lifetime total, or by that year's total when you pick a year above.

Track of the year

The 25 songs on repeat each year, ranked by play count — or switch to all time above. Filtering by artist searches your complete history, not just the displayed list.

Weekly rhythm

Plays by day of week, colored by genre — adjusted to Pacific time so late-night plays land on the right day. Reacts to the genre and year filters above.

Lyrical themes over time

Recurring lyrical themes across your top 500 tracks (via topic modeling over Genius lyrics), blended into each month by how many times you actually played that song then. Independent of the filters above — this runs on real calendar months from your listening history, not the site's folded years.

Built from Spotify Extended Streaming History. Plays under 30 seconds are excluded to filter out skips. 2010's handful of plays (the export begins March 2010) are folded into 2011, and 2026's partial year is folded into 2025.
